purpose: A titled region of a page: heading, optional description and actions, then its content. The danger variant is the danger zone.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence under the heading, at most about 140 characters

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level; 2 (default) for page sections, 3 inside another section

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links for the whole section, shown beside the heading

props.name: variant
props.description: plain (default) has no panel; surface adds a bordered panel; danger is the danger zone, with a danger border

whenToUse: To group related fields or content under a heading on a page
danger for destructive actions such as deleting an account, always the last section
whenNotToUse: For a clickable or selectable container — use Card
For a page title — the page template owns the h1
antiPatterns: Destructive actions outside a danger section
Skipping heading levels, such as an h3 section directly under the h1
A Section with only a heading and no content

typography: Heading h3 appearance at level 2, h4 at level 3; description body 2 secondary

a11yNotes: A region landmark named by its heading (aria-labelledby)
headingLevel keeps the outline continuous: h1 page title, h2 sections, h3 sub-sections
